senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מוּט)to be thin, minute.—Part. pass. מָעוּט, f. מְעוּטָה; pl. מְעוּטִים, מְעוּטִין; מְעוּטוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:2:10">Y. Pes. V, 32ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:16">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>גסי רוח ומְעוּטֵי תודה</he> big in spirit (haughty) and small in learning (of narrow capacity).
<cite ref="Tosefta Challah 1:7">Tosef. Ḥall. I, 7</cite>; a. e.—
Tam. IV, 2 במעוטה at least (Talm. ed. 31ᵃ במעוטן, comment. במיעוטן on the smallest of the tables).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:10">Ab. IV, 10</cite> <he>הוי מְמַעֵט בעסק וכ׳</he> do less business, and busy thyself with the Law.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22a">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01054"><he>עֵסֶק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 1:7">Taan. I, 7</cite> <he>מְמַעֲטִין במשא וכ׳</he> we must reduce business transactions, building &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:6">Ib. IV, 6</cite> <he>משנכנס אב ממעטין בשמחה</he> with the beginning of the month of Ab we must reduce rejoicing.
<cite ref="Chullin 60b:2">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לכי ומַעֲטִי את עצמך</he> go and make thyself smaller (be reduced).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:9">Snh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>הואיל ומִיעַטְתֶּם עצמיכם</he> because you made yourselves small (were modest); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15">Num. R. s. 15</cite>. Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 15 <he>מִיעֲטָהּ באבנים וכ׳</he> if he reduced the size of the gap by means of stones &c. Y. ib. VII, beg. 24ᵇ <he>ממעטין בכלים</he> you may use utensils for reducing the opening. Bab. ib. 77ᵇ <he>ממעט</he> effects the reduction, i.e. puts the two adjoining places in the legal condition of dwellings connected by a gate; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (interpret.) to limit, qualify, exclude from the rule.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 26a:6">Shebu. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>היה דורש את כל התורה בריבה ומיעט</he> interpreted the entire Law on the principle of ‘It includes and it excludes’, i.e. on the principle that if, in the Biblical text, a specification is preceded and followed by general terms, both an extension (<cite ref="T00586"><he>ריבוי</he></cite>) and a limitation (<cite ref="M01259"><he>מיעוט</he></cite>) must be found; e. g.

<cite ref="Shevuot 26a:2-12">ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 5:4">Lev. V, 4</cite>) <he>או נפש … להרע … מי׳ וכ׳</he> ‘or if a soul swears’, this is a general expression, ‘for bad or for good’, this limits (the sphere of the law to things which are either an advantage or a disadvantage); ‘whatsoever it be &c.’, this is again a generalization; now what does it include? All kinds of words (vows); <he>ומאי מ׳ מ׳ וכ׳</he> and what does it exclude? It excludes a religious act (the vow of doing a forbidden thing or not doing a commanded thing). Sifra Tsav, ch. XV, Par. 11 <he>אם מִיעַטְתִּים מסמיכה מרובה לא אֲמַעֲטֵם בתנופה וכ׳</he> if I exclude them (the gentiles) from the privilege of laying hands on the sacrifice, which has a wider sphere of application, must I not exclude them from the privilege of waving &c.?; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְמוּעָט</he>, v. <cite ref="M00561"><he>מוּעָט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:8">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא תאמר אני מרבה והוא מַמְעִיט</he> lest you say, I do much good, and he but little; <he>שנינו אחד המרבה ואחד הממעיט וכ׳</he> we have learned, whether one does much or little (they are equally worthy), provided one directs his heart &c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 13:11">Men. XIII, 11</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 7:5">Erub. VII, 5</cite> <he>נ׳ התבן מעשרה וכ׳</he> if the pile of straw has been reduced to less than ten handbreadths.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:9">Ib. 54ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19a:14">Ab. Zar. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְמַעֵט</he> he will become less (will decline in learning).
<cite ref="Arakhin 30b:53">Arakh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ כספו</he> if his value was reduced.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:10">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 10</cite> <he>נִתְמַעֲטוּ הימים וכ׳</he> the days were reduced, and the years shortened.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:10">Ib.</cite> <he>התחילו הגוים להתרבות וישראל להִתְמעֵט</he> the nations began to grow and the Israelites to be reduced (in rank).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> <he>נִתְמַעֲטָה ידו</he> he became reduced in fortune.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XII</cite>, end <he>נפשם מִתְמַעֶטֶת עליהם</he> their soul within them shrinks, i.e. they feel jealous and angry; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 659:2">Yalk. ib. 659</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>, beg. <he>מתמענת</he> (corr. acc.). Sifra l. c. <he>נִתְמַעֶטֶת תנופה</he> the sphere of the act of waving is the smaller one; <he>נִתְמַעֲטָה סמיכה</he> the laying on of hands has the smaller sphere; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 80b:11">Erub. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי נתמעט נתמטמט</he> ‘it was reduced’ (Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 7:7">ib. VII, 7</cite>) means, it was reduced to atoms, v. <cite ref="M01027"><he>מִטְמֵט</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 71a">B. Mets. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>נכסיו מִתְמַעֲטִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M00458"><he>מוּט</he></cite> h.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:1">Tosef. Mikv. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:14">VII</cite>), 14 <he>מִתְמַעֲטִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M02121"><he>מָעַךְ</he></cite>.
